description.zh: 模拟 Codex exec.rs 的完整 Shell 执行路径：process_exec_tool_call() 入口 → build_exec_request() 构建请求 → select_process_exec_tool_sandbox_type() 选择沙箱 → spawn_child_async() 启动子进程 → consume_output() 三路并行监控（stdout / stderr / 超时） → finalize_exec_result() 聚合输出。全程对应 core/src/exec.rs 实际代码。
description.en: Simulate Codex exec.rs full shell execution: process_exec_tool_call() entry → build_exec_request() → select_process_exec_tool_sandbox_type() → spawn_child_async() → consume_output() three-way parallel (stdout/stderr/timeout) → finalize_exec_result().

steps.content:
// exec.rs:219 — ShellHandler 调用总入口
pub async fn process_exec_tool_call(
  params: ExecParams,
  sandbox_policy: &SandboxPolicy,
  file_system_sandbox_policy: &FileSystemSandboxPolicy,
  network_sandbox_policy: NetworkSandboxPolicy,
  sandbox_cwd: &AbsolutePathBuf,
  codex_linux_sandbox_exe: &Option<PathBuf>,
  use_legacy_landlock: bool,
  stdout_stream: Option<StdoutStream>,
) -> Result<ExecToolCallOutput>

annotation.zh: exec.rs:219 — process_exec_tool_call() 是 Shell 工具的统一执行入口，接收 ExecParams 和各平台沙箱策略参数
annotation.en: exec.rs:219 — process_exec_tool_call() is the unified shell tool entry point, receives ExecParams and platform sandbox policy params

annotation.zh: exec.rs:83 — ExecParams 携带命令、工作目录、超时策略。DEFAULT_EXEC_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000（10 秒）
annotation.en: exec.rs:83 — ExecParams carries command, cwd, expiration. DEFAULT_EXEC_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000 (10s)

annotation.zh: exec.rs:131 — 根据 FileSystemSandboxPolicy + NetworkSandboxPolicy + 平台自动选择沙箱后端，在 spawn 前完成，不可运行时切换
annotation.en: exec.rs:131 — Auto-selects sandbox backend from fs/network policy + platform, decided before spawn, cannot switch at runtime

annotation.zh: exec.rs:245 — build_exec_request() 转换为平台相关的 ExecRequest，若有 NetworkProxy 则调用 network.apply_to_env() 注入代理环境变量
annotation.en: exec.rs:245 — build_exec_request() converts to platform-specific ExecRequest; calls network.apply_to_env() if NetworkProxy present

annotation.zh: exec.rs:877 — spawn_child_async() 产生实际的 tokio::process::Child。StdioPolicy::RedirectForShellTool 将 stdout/stderr 设为 piped，以便后续异步读取
annotation.en: exec.rs:877 — spawn_child_async() spawns actual tokio::process::Child. StdioPolicy::RedirectForShellTool pipes stdout/stderr for async reading

annotation.zh: exec.rs:1234 — consume_output() 启动两个异步 read_capped 任务，再用 tokio::select! 竞争进程退出 / 超时 / 取消三个事件
annotation.en: exec.rs:1234 — consume_output() spawns two read_capped tasks, then tokio::select! races process exit / timeout / cancellation

annotation.zh: 子进程运行中（pid=18372）。read_capped() 持续从 pipe 读取 stdout 增量，每次读到数据就通过 StdoutStream 推送 ExecCommandOutputDeltaEvent 给 TUI 实时展示
annotation.en: Child process running (pid=18372). read_capped() continuously reads stdout increments, pushes ExecCommandOutputDeltaEvent via StdoutStream to TUI

annotation.zh: exec.rs:80 — IO_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000。child.wait() 返回后，最多等 2 秒让 pipe reader 任务完成，防止孙进程持有文件描述符导致 read() 阻塞
annotation.en: exec.rs:80 — IO_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000. After child.wait(), wait up to 2s for pipe reader tasks to finish, preventing fd hold by grandchild processes

annotation.zh: exec.rs:57 — 超时时 kill_child_process_group() 终止整个进程组，exit_code 被 finalize_exec_result() 强制覆盖为 EXEC_TIMEOUT_EXIT_CODE = 124
annotation.en: exec.rs:57 — On timeout, kill_child_process_group() kills the entire process group; exit_code is overridden to EXEC_TIMEOUT_EXIT_CODE = 124 by finalize_exec_result()

annotation.zh: exec.rs:640 — finalize_exec_result() 聚合 stdout/stderr 输出，生成 ExecToolCallOutput（定义在 protocol/src/exec_output.rs:40），再转换为 ResponseInputItem 写回 session history
annotation.en: exec.rs:640 — finalize_exec_result() aggregates stdout/stderr into ExecToolCallOutput (defined in protocol/src/exec_output.rs:40), converted to ResponseInputItem for session history
